g.text: A smaller sensing footprint preserves fine detail at the same quadtree depth
White slash = mixed cell: all requirements retained. Each raster panel uses a separate D6 root domain.
Assumed line widths and 3 m entrance vicinities are explicit model inputs. This is no movement or privacy experiment.
